A lightweight and efficient client for Tailscale network. Ready to connect your devices easily.

By default, TailSocks operates in userspace-networking mode, which does not require root or special VPN permissions. For transparently routing all device traffic, you can enable TUN mode inside the app settings.
Are you experiencing issues connecting to the Tailscale coordination server? Enable ByeByeDPI to automatically bypass censorship and packet inspection.

To begin, authorize your device. If standard web login doesn\'t load, you can configure an Auth Key or OAuth client credentials in your Profile settings later. Please grant notifications permission to run in the background.
Login via Auth Key or OAuth

If standard web login fails to load or the key login button doesn\'t appear immediately on the webpage, you can use an Auth Key or OAuth client credentials. These can be configured in Settings -> Profile tab.
